rows.rationale: Test the native Mathlib homMk and canonical InvStruct.isEquivalence APIs directly, without a redundant client for the removed inverse-data theorem. Retain independent-universe nerve checks, the forward Fin 2 obstruction, and original authorship.

Use the public range equivalence to obtain actual corner preimages from either coordinate, and test that the pair of vertices is absent when both maps are the boundary inclusion of the zero-simplex. Retain original author credit.
